_readme: S380 SkyAlder, 2026-10-13. Coastline's capture (run 38406172949) found a page for 29 of its 159 programs with a course list: 109 found none and 21 lost a shared page. Its catalog sets programs at /coastline/pathways/<area>/<subject>/<program>/, and several subject pages (business/, accounting/, cybersecurity/) were claimed by more than one program. Business A.S. 23043, Management A.S. 03723, Supervision A.A. 03724 and Marketing A.S. 23047 found no page. This read loads the Business Operations & Management area page and its business subject page, tabs opened, to see where those programs print their requirements. Two page loads, no model call.

questions.program_pages: Which pages the area lists for Business, Management, Supervision, Marketing and Human Resources Management, and whether each program has its own page.
questions.requirements_place: Where a subject page prints each program's requirements (a tab per award, a block per award), and which course codes they name.
